overview.description: The Global X Zero Coupon Bond 2035 ETF (ZCBG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund provides exposure to zero-coupon US Treasury STRIPS scheduled to mature in 2035. The fund is designed to liquidate around November 30, 2035, with remaining assets distributed to shareholders at maturity. ZCBG was launched on Jan 6, 2026 and is issued by Global X.
